label: livery
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, which livery change came immediately after the darker olive green livery introduced by Maunsell, considering only the livery changes from the Grouping up to and including 1941?
criterion: a dated event in which a new livery is introduced or applied to the class or to some of its locomotives
why_needs_multiple: Cần chuỗi thay màu sơn trong phạm vi để xác định mốc kế tiếp sau mốc 1925.

gold_events.text: Class repainted in darker olive green livery introduced by Maunsell.
Nos. 1413 and 1850 painted in unlined olive green because of labour shortages

label: livery
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the livery changes from the start of the Second World War up to and including the malachite green repainting.
criterion: a dated livery change applied to the class or to some of its locomotives, from the start of WWII up to the 1946 malachite green repaint
why_needs_multiple: Bốn lần đổi sơn trong giai đoạn chiến tranh và sau chiến tranh, mốc e28 là approximate_date nên chỉ ghi vào flagged_ids.

gold_events.text: Nos. 1413 and 1850 painted in unlined olive green because of labour shortages
Nos. 1821, 1825, 1847, 1878 and 1403 run in unlined olive green with Bulleid's gilt block lettering
All N class locomotives painted in plain black during wartime shortages.
Two locomotives (Nos. 1817 and 1854) repainted in Bulleid's malachite green livery

label: livery
question: How many calendar years passed between Maunsell's darker olive green repaint of the class and the repainting of the class into British Railways mixed-traffic lined black livery?
why_needs_multiple: Khoảng cách năm giữa hai đợt đổi sơn, cần đúng hai mốc có năm.
criterion: e14 (darker olive green livery introduced by Maunsell) and e34 (British Railways mixed-traffic lined black livery)

gold_events.text: Class repainted in darker olive green livery introduced by Maunsell.
Repainted in BR mixed-traffic livery and renumbered to BR standard series (31810-31875, 31400-31414).

label: withdrawal
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, which step in the class's phased withdrawal from operational service came immediately after the withdrawal of the members based at Exmouth Junction shed?
criterion: a dated step in the phased withdrawal of the class from operational service
why_needs_multiple: Chuỗi rút khỏi hoạt động gồm ba bước; cần mốc kế tiếp sau bước giữa.

gold_events.text: Members based at Exmouth Junction shed withdrawn.
Last operational N class locomotives (Nos. 31405, 31408) withdrawn.

label: preserved No. 1874
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the later history of the preserved locomotive No. 1874, from its withdrawal for firebox reconstruction onward.
criterion: events in the later history of the preserved No. 1874 from its firebox-related withdrawal onward (includes the 2014 overhaul start, which carries track work)
why_needs_multiple: Bốn mốc lịch sử sau khi máy được rút khỏi hoạt động vì tái tạo hộp lửa; cần đủ cả bốn.

gold_events.text: Preserved No. 1874 withdrawn because of firebox reconstruction needs
Preserved No. 1874 repainted into SR Wartime Black
Preserved locomotive moved from the Mid-Hants Railway to the Swanage Railway
Overhaul to return No. 31874 to operational condition began
